# Releasing ConfluencePSnnConfluencePS releases are tag-driven from `master`.nn## Stepsnn1. Ensure CI is green on `master`.n2. Update `CHANGELOG.md`.n3. Update `ConfluencePS/ConfluencePS.psd1` version metadata if needed.n4. Push an annotated tag:nn```bashngit checkout masterngit pull --ff-only origin masterngit tag -a vX.Y.Z -m "Release vX.Y.Z"ngit push origin master --tagsn```nnThe `release.yml` workflow then:n- Downloads the `Release` artifact from a successful `ci.yml` run for the tagged commit.n- Publishes to PowerShell Gallery.n- Creates a GitHub release.n
